member.name: T:SchoolLostAndFound.DatabaseHelper
member.summary:
Centralized database helper for all OleDb operations against the SchoolLostAndFound.mdb database. Every form and module in the application uses this class instead of creating its own connections.
IMPORTANT: This class uses Microsoft.Jet.OLEDB.4.0 for .mdb files. The project must target x86 to use the 32-bit Jet provider.
Security.InitializeDatabase migrates legacy passwords to salted PBKDF2 hashes.

member.name: T:SchoolLostAndFound.SessionManager
member.summary:
Stores information about the currently logged-in user for the duration of the application session. This is a Shared (static) class — there is no need to create an instance.
After a successful login, the Login form sets these properties. All other forms read them to determine the current user's identity and role. On logout, call SessionManager.Clear() to reset all values.
